title: Swap rates hit three-year high as bond sell-off looms
summary:
UK homeowners face the prospect of higher mortgage rates as swap rates reached their highest level in three years, driven by volatility in global bond markets and rising oil prices. The five-year swap rate climbed above 4.52% on Wednesday, marking the highest level since October 2023.

title: Crest Nicholson forecasts £10m loss amid weak market
summary:
British housebuilder Crest Nicholson has issued its third profit warning since April, forecasting a £10 million operating loss for the year ending October. The company will complete fewer homes than expected amid subdued market conditions and affordability constraints.

title: Lomond expands into Bristol with 12-branch acquisition
summary:
Lomond has acquired Ocean Property Services Group, adding 12 branches to its network and establishing a new regional hub in Bristol. The transaction strengthens the group's presence in the South West property market.

title: Unclaimed tenancy deposits could total £750m in England and Wales
summary:
An estimated £750 million in unclaimed tenancy deposits may be sitting dormant within England and Wales' deposit protection system, according to new analysis. The figure has emerged as the government reviews tenancy deposit protection frameworks, with calls for greater transparency similar to Scotland's approach.

title: Landlords increasingly require guarantors as rent caps take effect
summary:
More than half of landlords are now more likely to request a guarantor from tenants who do not comfortably meet standard affordability checks, according to new research from LRG. The shift comes as property owners can no longer request more than one month's rent in advance under the Renters' Rights Act.

title: High street decline raises concerns for estate agencies
summary:
Estate agency owners are facing mounting pressure as high street footfall continues to decline, driven by council parking policies and competition from out-of-town retail developments. Online purchases now account for 36% of all retail spend in the UK.

title: Estate agency calls for eight-week completion target
summary:
A UK estate agency chief executive has called for property transaction times to be reduced to eight weeks, citing that average completions currently take between 16 to 18 weeks. Nick Goble of Noble Estates has introduced new processes that have reportedly reduced delays by two to three weeks.

title: Property transactions take 216 days as communication gaps persist
summary:
The average home move in Great Britain now takes 216 days from first listing to completion, with 72% of recent home movers experiencing delays. New research reveals significant communication gaps between estate agents, conveyancers, and other property professionals, with differing priorities on how to resolve transaction delays.

title: Propertymark criticises Scottish housing programme
summary:
The Scottish Government's latest Programme for Government has drawn criticism from Propertymark for insufficient attention to the country's housing emergency. The trade body highlighted gaps in measures to address rising rents and housing affordability.
